decision.message: Selected esp32_sht31_v1/standard from the source-bound requirement extraction. Operating limits are declared bounds, not measurements. The fixed catalog conditions and separate firmware/assembly/bench obligations still apply.

clauses.text: Would you make an indoor temperature and humidity monitor for me? Please use your standard profile, 70 pF total bus capacitance, and the reviewed default electrical and ambient limits. I don't need pressure measurement. Thanks!
